Kwon Hyuk-bin founded Smilegate in 2002; Smilegate is the maker of Crossfire, Lost Ark, and other games.
Kwon Hyuk-bin holds an electrical engineering degree from Sogang University.

Ding Lei, also known as William Ding, founded NetEase in June 1997 and is its founder/CEO; NetEase is an online and mobile games business, and Ding's fortune came largely from video games including Fantasy Westward Journey.
Ding Lei earned a degree in communication technology from the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China; at the time of the 2019 article, he was married but without children.

Sophie (Sophie Xeon), a Scottish DJ and producer, died aged 34 on 30 January 2021 after an accidental fall while watching the full moon; the accident was reported to have taken place in Athens, Greece.
In a later online tribute, Sophie's partner Evita Manji said, "She's an immaterial girl now; she can be anything she wants... and she is in everything around us."

Alka Marwaha is an associate professor of Mathematics at Jesus and Mary College, University of Delhi, India, and the author of The Secret World of Vipassana and Mathematics (Wisdom Tree Publishers, November 15, 2016), a book exploring the singularity between Vipassana and Mathematics.
Alka Marwaha was awarded the Commonwealth Scholarship to pursue a PhD in Mathematics at Dalhousie University, Canada, where she also received the Izaak Walton Killam Scholarship.

Alka Marwaha authored the article "Finding the mathematical overlaps of the axiom of choice in Vipassana meditation," published in the International Journal of Statistics and Applied Mathematics in 2022 (vol. 7, issue 3, pp. 110-114).
Leonhard Euler was born on 15 April 1707 in Basel, Swiss Confederacy.
Stiff person syndrome symptoms usually develop over months to years and may remain stable for many years or slowly worsen.

Stiff person syndrome may initially cause aching discomfort, stiffness, or pain, especially in the lower back, hips, and/or legs; it may also affect the shoulders, arms, and/or neck, and progressive leg stiffness can lead to a slow, stiff manner of walking.

In individuals with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP), trauma to the muscles, such as a fall or invasive medical procedures, may trigger episodes of muscle swelling and inflammation (myositis) followed by more rapid ossification in the injured area.
The 2023 master's thesis '"Is EU4 Only About Map Painting?": Settler Colonial Ideology in Europa Universalis IV' was written by Mitchell Losito at Georgetown University.
Amanda D. Phillips was the advisor for the 2023 Georgetown University master's thesis on Europa Universalis IV.
The Rights of Man manual credits the content designers, in listed order, as Henrik Lohmander, Milla Isaksson, and Mathilda Bjarnehed.
Mathilda Bjarnehed is the third content designer credited for the Rights of Man downloadable content.
Jerry Mao is an Australian competitive programmer who won a bronze medal at IOI 2015, a silver medal at IOI 2016, a gold medal at IOI 2017, and a silver medal at IOI 2018.

Jerry Mao was a member of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology team MIT ZEROONE (with Mingyang Deng and Xiao Mao), which won the ICPC 2021 World Finals Dhaka (held on 10 November 2022) as World Champion.
The host university for the ICPC 2021 World Finals Dhaka was the University of Asia Pacific (UAP).

A letter from King Michael of Romania to the President of the United States was transmitted to the President under cover of a memorandum dated March 5, 1945, from William J. Donovan, Director of the Office of Strategic Services.
King Michael handed the letter to an OSS officer in Bucharest with the statement that he was pleased to have an opportunity to transmit his views to the President unofficially.
In the letter, King Michael refers to Romania having regained North Transylvania.
